title: Shapley subset marginal distribution
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $J$ be a subset of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$. Sample a subset according to the Shapley subset distribution on $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ and restrict it to $J$. The resulting probability mass function is the distribution of that restricted subset.
caveat: The underlying Shapley subset distribution and the restriction operation are not defined in the supplied material.
